metadata.description: Observe IE Marketplace — plugins for Observe Integration Engineering work (knowledge capture, query optimization, dashboard design + migration, brand assets).

plugins.name: opal-optimizer
plugins.description: Autonomous OPAL query optimization loop for Observe monitors and queries

plugins.name: snowflake-brand
plugins.description: Snowflake brand guidelines for designs, code, presentations, and marketing materials

plugins.name: observeie-plugin
plugins.description: Observe IE bundle — ObserveIE agent + Dashboard Designer + Dashboard Migrator + Observe CLI skill + auto-learning capture pipeline. The single plugin for the full Observe Integration Engineer workflow.

plugins.name: observeie-plugin-v2
plugins.description: Observe IE bundle v2 — everything in observeie-plugin PLUS a 7-phase safety harness: tenant guardrails, destructive-op approval tokens, multi-agent widget validation (Builder/Validator/Skeptic), parallel build with layout agent, auto-review with undo window, dataset-creation workflow, and knowledge-graph detection. Install side-by-side with v1 to A/B test.

plugins.name: observe-learning
plugins.description: Auto-capture Observe-platform learnings from Claude Code sessions for cross-customer knowledge propagation. Stop-hook classifier + /observe-capture + /observe-review slash commands.

plugins.name: dashboard-designer
plugins.description: Design Observe dashboards from intent. Carries verified vegaVis shapes, 12-column grid conventions, OPAL idioms per viz type, drill-down patterns, and the schema-first → deploy → screenshot-verify workflow.

plugins.name: dashboard-migrator
plugins.description: Translate Datadog dashboard JSON exports into working Observe dashboards. Encodes dataset-shape dispatch, DD APM idioms, DD query grammar → OPAL mapping, and vegaVis wiring quirks. Hands off to dashboard-designer for final polish.
